author: Lucartex
body:
uWant credits? Then all you have to do is:
Go to: My map Here and there ( https://avicus.net/forums/849b70fa6  )


Rate the map with either + or -
AND write what you think about it.
Note that you dont have to rate good, critical comments
are allowed too of course!


Thanks for participating.
Expires in one week (Friday) end of the day

For those who think I'm only doing this for my map:
Partly, because I want more feedback, but I also like to give credits to people who want or need them more than me :)
